title: Astrid and the Alibi
author: T. M. Sterling
blurb: Odile Winterbourne, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
